# StoryBook Public Content Guidance for LLMs

The following paths contain public content intended for indexing and citation:

- Public Company Profile: /@company_slug
- Project Details: /@company_slug/project_slug
- Episode Player: /@company_slug/project_slug/e/episode_slug

Structure:
- Company Pages list available projects.
- Project Pages list available episodes with descriptions.
- Episode Pages contain video player (YouTube/Facebook embed), transcript (if available), and metadata.

Restricted Areas:
- /admin: Administrative interface (Login required)
- /home: User dashboard (Login required)
- /auth: Authentication flows

Structured Data:
- Pages include JSON-LD for Organization, TVSeries, and TVEpisode types.
